scope: Every bundled regional identity and alias: route identity, monthly offsets and civil dates for 2026–2035, plus one-second checks around every bundled correction transition. Expected values come from separately compiled official IANA data through Python zoneinfo.
limits: Not every historical instant or future political change is verified.
Other browsers may carry different timezone versions. Corrections cover only the seven explicitly bundled regions in 2026–2035.
This is systematic programmatic curation, not a native-language or subject-expert editorial review of each location.
